description.value: Tobiko Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant inside Fleetwood Plaza on Fraser Highway in Surrey, operating as 'Tobiko Sushi 1' — the first of what appears to be a multi-location operation. The menu spans classic rolls, nigiri, sashimi, and an extensive lineup of party trays in sizes from 33 to 104 pieces. Both dine-in and online takeout ordering are available, making it a functional meal stop for cyclists moving along the Fraser Highway corridor.
